app.title: Visit Oman
app.description: Discover destinations across Oman and build a deterministic travel plan.

home.heroTitle: Curated discovery for coastlines, mountain air, forts, and desert nights.
home.heroBody: Browse a bilingual, server-rendered collection of destinations across Oman, then move straight into a planner that turns your interests into an itinerary.
home.sectionsBody: Every category below is generated from the destination dataset, with sample places and direct access into discovery.
home.regionsBody: Move between cultural cities, highland villages, wadis, beaches, and monsoon landscapes with dataset-backed regional picks.
home.featuredBody: A premium shortlist of lower-crowd, high-value places to start your trip planning.
home.plannerBody: Save standout places while browsing, then open the planner to generate a deterministic itinerary and cost view.

discover.title: Discover Oman
discover.body: Browse server-rendered destination listings with shareable URL filters for region, category, season, and traveler-friendly sorting.
discover.plannerBridgeBody: Save destinations while browsing, then open the planner to turn those interests into a deterministic itinerary.
discover.emptyState: Try broadening the season, switching regions, or clearing filters to reopen the catalogue.

detail.mapBody: The page loads with a server-rendered Oman locator immediately, then enhances to a live map once the client is ready.

saved.title: Saved interests
saved.emptyBody: Start in discovery and save destinations here before opening the planner.
saved.body: These destinations are stored locally in the browser and can prefill planner inputs.

plannerForm.title: Planner input
plannerForm.body: Choose the exact trip inputs used by the planner. Duration, budget, travel month, pace, and preferred categories directly affect the itinerary.
plannerForm.savedHint: Saved destinations shape the default category selection. You can still edit the categories manually.
plannerForm.validationRequired: Complete all required fields before continuing.
plannerForm.validationCategories: Select at least one preferred category.

plannerResult.title: Final itinerary
plannerResult.body: A traveler-facing plan built from ranked stops, regional allocation, and timed daily routing.
plannerResult.storageStatus: Itinerary and cost breakdown are stored locally for continuity across refresh and navigation. Last updated:
plannerResult.mapBody: Switch days to review the route order, focus individual stops, and keep the itinerary list synchronized with the map.
plannerResult.daySelectorBody: Each tab keeps the same itinerary context while focusing a different day and route.
plannerResult.dayExplanationsTitle: Why these stops made the cut
plannerResult.timelineBody: Read the day in order, compare paid and free stops, and see why each stop survived scoring and repair.
plannerResult.noStops: No stops assigned for this day.
plannerResult.whyBody: The plan below explains why this region, these stops, and this cost profile survived deterministic scoring and repair.
plannerResult.regionAllocationBody: Days are assigned with bounded search, hard caps, and contiguous regional blocks before daily routing starts.
plannerResult.regionAllocationNoUnallocated: Every viable region was allocated at least one day.
plannerResult.whyRegionBody: {region} holds {count} strong-ranked candidates, making it the best day {dayNumber} fit with {factors}.
plannerResult.whyBudgetNoRepair: No budget repair swaps were needed. The current trip remains {status}.
plannerResult.whyBudgetWithRepair: {count} repair moves reduced ticket pressure by {savings}. The current trip now sits {status}.
plannerResult.selectionFactorBudget: {budget} budget shaped paid versus free stops
plannerResult.selectionFactorPace: {pace} pace capped the day at {cap} stops
plannerResult.selectionFactorRegions: {count} regions were distributed across the trip
plannerResult.reasonSeason: {name} is especially well timed for your travel month.
plannerResult.reasonDiversity: {name} adds variety to the mix of places in your trip.
plannerResult.reasonBudget: {name} helped the itinerary stay aligned with the selected budget tier.
plannerResult.reasonCrowd: {name} matches the crowd comfort level implied by your pace.
plannerResult.reasonDetour: {name} kept the route compact and reduced unnecessary detours.
plannerResult.reasonFallback: {name} remained one of the strongest regional matches after deterministic routing.
